chunks: And indeed, over you are guardians.
ai.seo_question: Who are the guardians mentioned in Surah Al-Infitar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the dual presence of recording angels (Kiraman Katibin) who meticulously document human deeds, reinforcing the concept of divine omniscience. It serves as a profound reminder of individual accountability, urging believers to maintain mindfulness (muraqabah) of their actions in preparation for the Day of Judgment.
